description: Risco de Ruptura de Barragens is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil. Dam Break Risk Mapping - Belonging to the document "National Risk Assessment (2019)". Coverage: Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil. The portal shows the English title as "Risk of Dam Breakage" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil. Its keywords include ruptura-de-barragens, infofeatureaccessservice, anepc, localizacao, cartografia-oficial, seguranca. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
